summary.text: Martin Carbaugh is a Republican state representative from Indiana House District 81 who has represented the district since 2012 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
The other candidate on the general election ballot is Sharon Wight, the Democratic nominee.

paragraphs.text: Carbaugh attended Concordia High School and works as a financial advisor with WestPoint Financial.
He took office in the Indiana House on November 7, 2012.
